title: Delete Part on a part with an open return shows why and does nothing
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • Part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-DELRET-01) is stocked at {Location-A} with 3 on hand.
  • Vendor {Vendor-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL DELRET Vendor) exists.
  • Vendor return {Return-A} for {Part-A} is saved and not completed.
custom_steps:
1. Type {Part-A} in the Inventory search.
  2. Click the {Part-A} row.
  3. Hover over Delete Part.
  4. Click Delete Part.
  5. Click Cancel.
  6. Type {Part-A} in the search.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: a tooltip reads "Please complete or cancel the related return or credit first."
  • Step 4: nothing happens; the window stays open.
  • Step 6: {Part-A} is still listed.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S13-R28, §8 User Feedback Summary, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 6.6 (Vendor return: still offered, tagged), 13 Oct copy. Tech plan §6 Phase 6 frontend (Delete trap). Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S13-R28: “When the part has a return or credit that is not completed, Delete Part does nothing and hovering it shows "Please complete or cancel the related return or credit first."”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Delete Part hovered on a part with an open return or credit): “"Please complete or cancel the related return or credit first." | Tooltip”
  • Tech plan, 7 Oct 2026, §6 Phase 6 frontend (Delete trap): “It stays enabled and no-ops, so the S13-R27/R28 tooltip fires”
